env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd m
logos run .
stdout '^sum 8$'
cp stdout $WORK/run-stdout.txt

logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
grep 'go group\(' out/main.go
grep 'NewGroup\(' out/main.go

cd out
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/run-stdout.txt

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/ejectgroupplain

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
)

var plainCh = make(chan int, 8)

//logos:allow(correctness::unbounded_channel_op)
func group(n int) {
	plainCh <- n + 41
}

func runPlain(ctx context.Context, input int) error {
	go group (ctx) {
		go group(input)
	}
	return nil
}

//logos:allow(correctness::unbounded_channel_op)
func main() {
	ctx := context.Background()
	go group(7)
	input := 1
	if err := runPlain(ctx, input); err != nil {
		fmt.Println("bad err")
		return
	}
	a := <-plainCh
	b := <-plainCh
	fmt.Println("sum", a+b-82)
}
